verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee exposes natural-language-driven extraction via `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules` and NL-based Q&A through its ChatGPT/Gemini ask endpoints, plus an official MCP server that would let an AI agent invoke these capabilities conversationally. However, core operation (scraping config, proxies, JS scenarios, scheduling, CLI) still requires structured parameters/commands rather than free-form natural language, so full NL control of the product is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: evidence of a chat-style interface or NL command parser covering the full API surface (not just extraction/QA), and independent confirmation the MCP server supports conversational operation.
